reviews.title: Great Value Monitor for Everyday Use
reviews.comment: It is amazing the quality you can get for the price in monitors these days.  I needed an economical monitor for work at an alternate location for general emails, web surfing, office work.  This fits the bill perfectly.  The 2560x1440 native resolution is easy on the eyes for this type of work.  Can you game or photo edit with it? Yes, but a more expensive option would likely be better.  If you're just doing everyday work, its perfect - especially for the price point.  Mounted perfectly with the VESA mount on a swing arm for my setup.
reviews.author: Dandagreer

reviews.title: Nice monitor, but not compatible with my older Lenovo T420 Win 7 Laptop, so had to return.
reviews.comment: It was a nice looking monitor, good price, seemed good quality, but unfortunately it did not work with my Win 7 Lenovo T420 laptop....it would crash the video card driver, and usually lockup the laptop and require a hard shutdown. Could not turn off the monitor without it crashing the laptop, or disconnect and reconnect without crashing it. Could not get it to run at 2560x1440 without a custom resolution in Win7, and then it flickered a lot, and would turn off sometimes. Basically it was not compatible with the older Lenovo T420 with Nvidia NVS 4200M video card, and even when running it at 1920x1080 resolution, it still had basically the same problems...so had to knock off 1 star because it should have been able to work at a lower resolution, but it still had issues. I tested it on a newer Dell 5580 laptop and a new Linux Mint 22 desktop, and it worked flawlessly and looked great, so some kind of hardware compatibility issue with this monitor and older hardware like the T420. So had to return because I bought it for my T420.

reviews.title: Good 2nd monitor
reviews.comment:
You get what you pay for.
It's not as bright as my main gaming monitor (Dell G2724D).
No adjustable height- only tilts forward and back.
Only the bare bones connections- no USB-C connections.
Would not game on this monitor, but it's a good 2nd monitor to watch videos/streams.
reviews.author: Martin
